verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document Amplitude streaming events outbound to third-party destinations. The integrations page frames connections as bringing platforms into Amplitude ("Connect the leading data and marketing platforms to Amplitude"), and the directory entries for Salesforce and HubSpot only describe those vendors, not any outbound event stream. The Export API and cohort export are bulk-data building blocks, not a destination-streaming or webhook capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream events onward to third-party destinations (CRM, ad platforms, webhooks) from the analytics platform
